description: This file defines the ApiHealthCheck class, which implements health check logic for monitoring the health status of an API endpoint related to catalog items. It performs an HTTP GET request to a specified API URL and checks for a specific string in the response to determine healthiness.

classes.name: ApiHealthCheck
classes.description: A health check class that verifies the availability and correctness of an API endpoint related to catalog items.

methods.name: CheckHealthAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous check of the API health by sending an HTTP request and evaluating the response content for specific indicators of health.
